description: Submit a book on behalf of its author to eglise.shop (French store) or en.eglise.shop (English store). eglise.shop publishes Christian books from independent authors worldwide: 25% commission per sale, no subscription; paper, PDF and audio formats. NOTHING IS PUBLISHED AUTOMATICALLY: the author must confirm by e-mail (rights + 25% commission) within 48 h, then the eglise.shop team reviews the book and publishes it manually. Only submit with the author's explicit consent, using their real e-mail. Requirements: summary ≥ 200 characters, plain text only (no HTML), public https links to the manuscript (pdf/epub/docx/audio) and cover (jpg/png/webp), rights_confirmed=true. Limits: 3 submissions/day per author e-mail, 5/day per IP; duplicates within 30 days are refused. Unconfirmed submissions expire after 7 days. Authors page and terms: https://eglise.shop/comment-vendre-mes-livres-chretiens-dans-le-monde-entier/ — Track with submission_status. FR : proposez le livre d'un auteur chrétien sur eglise.shop (commission de 25 % par vente, sans abonnement ; papier, PDF, audio). Rien n'est publié automatiquement : l'auteur confirme par e-mail, puis l'équipe examine et publie à la main.

rights_confirmed.description: Must be true: the author states they hold the rights.

site.description: Boutique : "fr" = eglise.shop (≈5 600 livres en français, défaut), "en" = en.eglise.shop (≈2 800 livres en anglais).

summary.description: Plain-text summary, 200–4000 characters, at most 2 URLs (only the manuscript/cover links).
